name: Two Scoops
source:
You take on the role of a young woman who has just started a new job at a local, family-owned ice cream shop. She's taken on a big responsibility, too: two of the employees are going away soon, leaving her to fill their shoes! With only a week remaining before their departure, the situation seems tricky for our protagonist, but she is determined to show that she's the right one for the job, all while growing closer to her co-workers along the way.

[Edited from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1586864085/two-scoops-an-ice-cream-shop-dating-sim]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一位年轻女性的角色，她刚刚在当地一家家族经营的冰淇淋店开始了新工作。她也承担了重大责任：两名员工很快就要离开，留下她来填补空缺！距离他们出发只剩下一周了，对于我们的主角来说，情况似乎很棘手，但她决心证明自己是这份工作的合适人选，同时与同事们的关系也越来越亲密。

[编辑自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1586864085/two-scoops-an-ice-cream-shop-dating-sim]Kickstarter[/url]]
